summary: Supervisor lifecycle envelope around the bounded Tokio transactional outbox service loop.
claim_boundary: Supervisor lifecycle metadata only. This slice records start, ready, shutdown-requested, and stopped events around the existing bounded Tokio outbox service loop. It does not install an OS daemon, wire systemd/launchd/Kubernetes controllers, handle real SIGTERM, open a database pool, publish broker messages, or prove production delivery.

facets.F1_simplicity: The supervisor wrapper reuses the existing AsyncOutboxPollerCycleRunner, sleeper, and shutdown-signal traits instead of adding a new process framework or runtime dependency.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: Structured lifecycle reports provide the start/ready/stop envelope a future supervisor, readiness probe, or rollout controller can consume while keeping the runtime seam deterministic in tests.
facets.F3_adversarial: Tests cover invalid supervisor refs/timeouts, max-epoch stop, and shutdown-before-work so lifecycle reporting does not silently claim readiness or work after shutdown is requested.
facets.F4_api_contract: New public types OutboxSupervisorConfig, OutboxSupervisorLifecycleEvent, and OutboxSupervisorLifecycleReport wrap the existing OutboxPollerServiceReport without changing worker or poller contracts.
facets.F5_quality: Focused runtime tests plus the 45-package backbone check/test/clippy/fmt matrix, cargo-deny, license-policy, cargo-prefix, catalog/data-class known-blocker probes, parse/config validation, dependency-seam, honest-claims, and diff hygiene are part of this run.
facets.F6_operations: The service loop now has explicit lifecycle event metadata for future daemon composition, but operational process managers, real signal handlers, and deployment probes remain out of scope.
facets.F7_security_privacy: Lifecycle events carry service/worker refs, epoch counts, and stop reasons only; no message content, credentials, broker URLs, database URLs, or tenant secrets are introduced.
facets.F8_supply_chain: No new external dependency or Cargo.lock change is introduced by this slice; it extends an existing Tokio runtime app crate.
facets.F9_testing: Focused tests passed for 11 runtime unit tests and the broad backbone matrix passed 289 unit tests plus the existing ignored metrics adapter doctest.
facets.F10_ci_cd: The runtime app was already present in all four backbone CI/Jenkins package matrices; this slice does not claim remote CI execution.
facets.F11_observability: Lifecycle events expose structured service_ref, worker_ref, completed_epochs, and stop_reason fields that future tracing/metrics adapters can bind to without parsing log text.
facets.F13_reversibility: The change is isolated to one runtime app crate plus catalog/task/evidence metadata; reverting removes the supervisor envelope without affecting poller, worker, SQL, or transport seams.
